_comment: Demo stand-in for the team pipeline. Scores, labels and reasons are the FORGE engine's own results for these pages (python main.py on surabhi/demo_sites/serve.py; see tests/test_demo_sites.py). analyze.py turns this list into forge_state.json with screenshots.

suspects.label: likely_fake
reasons: +30: uses the brand's product photos (4 exact copies, 0 look-alikes).
+20: shows the brand's logo or favicon.

+15: prices at least 40% below the real store: Summit Shell Jacket at ₹1,299 vs ₹12,999 (90% off); Ridge 28L Pack at ₹649 vs ₹6,499 (90% off); Trail Runner GTX at ₹999 vs ₹8,999 (89% off); Thermal Flask 750 at ₹179 vs ₹1,799 (90% off).
+15: lists 1 phone/UPI/email contact that is not the brand's official ones (nsXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXpi).
Note (no points): scam-style phrases found: Huge discount, Countdown pressure, Claims to be official, Scarcity pressure, UPI only, No cash on delivery, No returns, WhatsApp-only contact.
